Name: Loot Goblin
Punchline: Automated treasure map hunting bot with party coordination.
Description: LootGoblin automates treasure map hunting by opening maps, reading local map flags, teleporting to the nearest aetheryte, coordinating with party members, and flying to the treasure location. Use /lootgoblin or /lg to open.
